title: ACT ON THE IMPLEMENTATION OF THE ARRANGEMENT BETWEEN THE KOREAN MISSION IN TAIPEI AND THE TAIPEI MISSION IN KOREA FOR THE AVOIDANCE OF DOUBLE TAXATION AND THE PREVENTION OF FISCAL EVASION WITH RESPECT TO TAXES ON INCOME
title_original: 주타이베이 대한민국 대표부와 주한국 타이베이 대표부 간의 소득에 관한 조세의 이중과세 방지와 탈세 예방을 위한 약정의 이행에 관한 법률
full_text:
Article 1 (Purpose)
The purpose of this Act is to prescribe matters necessary for the implementation of the Arrangement between the Korean Mission in Taipei and the Taipei Mission in Korea for the Avoidance of Double Taxation and the Prevention of Fiscal Evasion with Respect to Taxes on Income.

Article 2 (Implementation of Arrangement for Avoidance of Double Taxation and Prevention of Fiscal Evasion)
The arrangement concluded between the Korean Mission in Taipei and the Taipei Mission in Korea for the avoidance of double taxation and the prevention of fiscal evasion with respect to taxes on income shall be implemented in accordance with the attached Table.

ADDENDA <Act No. 19831, Dec. 26, 2023>

This Act shall enter into force on the date of its promulgation.

ADDENDA <Act No. 21065, Oct. 1, 2025>
(Government Organization Act)

Article 1 (Enforcement Date)
This Act shall enter into force on the date of its promulgation; provided, among the Acts amended pursuant to Article 7 of these Addenda, the parts amending Acts that have been promulgated before this Act enters into force but have not yet entered into force shall enter into force on the respective enforcement dates of those Acts, and the following amended provisions shall enter into force on the dates specified in the relevant subparagraphs:
1. The amended provisions specified in the following items shall enter into force on January 2, 2026; provided, among the Acts amended pursuant to Article 7 of these Addenda (limited to the parts related to the amended provisions specified in items (a) and (b)), the parts amending Acts that have been promulgated before the enforcement date under the main clause but have not yet entered into force by that enforcement date shall enter into force on the respective enforcement dates of those Acts:
(a) The amended provisions of Articles 19 (4), 23, 29 (1) 1, and 30;
(b) The amended provisions of Articles 12 (2), 19 (3), 22, and the proviso of Article 29 (2) (limited to the parts concerning the Minister of Finance and Economy and the Ministry of Finance and Economy);
(c) The Acts amended pursuant to Article 7 of these Addenda (limited to the parts related to the amended provisions specified in items (a) and (b)).
2. Omitted.

Articles 2 through 6 Omitted.

Article 7 (Amendments to Other Acts)
(1) through (108) Omitted.
(109) Part of the Act on the Implementation of the Arrangement between the Korean Mission in Taipei and the Taipei Mission in Korea for the Avoidance of Double Taxation and the Prevention of Fiscal Evasion with Respect to Taxes on Income shall be amended as follows:
In Article 3, subparagraph 1 (a) of the attached Table, "Ministry of Economy and Finance" shall be replaced by "Ministry of Finance and Economy"; and in item (g) 2) of the same subparagraph, "Minister of Economy and Finance" shall be replaced by "Minister of Finance and Economy".
(110) through (626) Omitted.

Article 8 Omitted.
